title: Policy Gate
description: policy-gate.sh - PreToolUse gate on Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|Bash. LAW 2, gate half: THIS HOOK FAILS CLOSED. If the policy file is unreadable or malformed, writes under the hardcoded fallback tree are DENIED and everything else is allowed - a broken policy can neither expose the protected tree nor brick the whole session. Two rings: 1. The record (RECORD_ROOT and .claude-iff/) is write-denied to EVERY identity, including the main session. It is written only by the capture hook's append and by obsctl. This is what "append-only" actually rests on; the committed anchor is what makes it evidence. 2. The protected tree (.claude/hooks, config, agents, protocols, settings) is main-session only. A sub-agent must never be able to edit the gate that polices it or the ritual registry it runs under. Identity comes from the payload's agent_type/agent_name; absent means the main session.
